name: firesight-psi-combustion
title: FireSight: NASA PSI combustion data for spacecraft and habitat fire safety
description: Data behind the FireSight dashboard (NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, team Spacecrammers). AI use: cleaning rules, digitized points, extracted tables and written summaries were produced with Claude (Anthropic); see AI_USE.md. Every value keeps its source.

tools: Google Gemini: live answers on the dashboard only, not in these files

licenses.name: CC0-1.0
licenses.title: NASA PSI data (psi.nasa.gov) are CC0; cite each investigation by its DOI

resources.name: tests
resources.description: Unified test matrix: 1,958 rows from 19 PSI experiment tables. Produced by scripts written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic). (scripts/normalize.py); src_file and src_row point to the PSI table row.
resources.x_ai_generated: cleaning rules written with Claude; values come from PSI

resources.name: quality_log
resources.description: 157 data-quality issues found while cleaning and what was done. Produced by scripts written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic).

resources.name: curated
resources.description: Investigation summaries, findings, relevance notes, incidents, spinoffs and references. Written by Claude from the sources named in each finding; checked against them on 2026-11-14.

resources.name: bundle
resources.description: Everything above merged for the page by scripts/build_data.py. Produced by scripts written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic).

resources.name: boundary_points
resources.description: 74 flammability-boundary points from the BASS-II Summary Report (NASA/TM-20210011385): Figure 6.10 digitized with Claude-written code and checked by Claude; Tables 7.1 and 2.1 copied by Claude. See boundary/README.md.

resources.name: boundary_model
resources.description: Fitted boundary curves, bootstrap bands and validation from scripts/flammability_boundary.py. Produced by scripts written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic).

resources.name: bre_iss_tests
resources.description: 83 ACME BRE ISS tests from Dehghani & Quintiere (2023), Combustion and Flame, Table A.1. Extracted by Claude and compared with the page images. See evidence/README.md.

resources.name: flex_loi_by_diluent
resources.description: FLEX limiting oxygen by diluent from Dietrich et al. (2014), abstract. Copied by Claude.

resources.name: same_smoke_particle_sizes
resources.description: SAME smoke particle sizes from the SAME Final Science Report (PSI-102), Table 1, p. 27. Copied by Claude.
